decision_summary.market_read: Bull Maduro regime with improving macro delta (+6.25 1w) supporting risk-on positioning, though healthcare concentration at 81.5% largecap weight demands diversification into non-correlated themes.

selected.reason_short: PCS 85.5 rot=8 bullish-aligned oil_gas diversifier with zero extension risk
selected.reason_full: VLE.TO posts PCS 85.5 with rotation score 8 on a 3-week unbroken streak delivering +10.1% 4w and +17.8% 13w outperformance vs SPY. Koncorde is fully bullish-aligned across daily, 3D, and weekly timeframes with green at 106.46 — the cleanest multi-timeframe confirmation among all PCS 85+ candidates not yet in the portfolio. Zero extension risk with no flags provides the most conservative entry in the oil_gas theme. Oil_gas at 13.5% portfolio weight addresses the extreme 81.5% healthcare_largecap concentration that is the primary portfolio risk.
selected.comparative_edge: Selected over TNZ.TO (PCS 88.5) because TNZ.TO carries spike_flag=true, konc_w_state=distribution yielding mixed alignment, and extension_risk=high (4 pts) versus VLE.TO's zero extension risk and fully bullish-aligned Koncorde — cleaner confirmation matters more than 3 points of PCS advantage.
key_supporting_factors: PCS 85.5 with rot=8 and 3-week streak demonstrates sustained institutional accumulation across weekly and daily timeframes.
Zero extension risk with no extension flags offers the cleanest entry among all PCS 85+ non-open candidates in the entire universe.
Bullish-aligned Koncorde across all three timeframes (daily up, 3D up, weekly up) confirms maximum structural support available.
Oil_gas turkey_oil subtheme at 13.5% portfolio weight diversifies from extreme 81.5% healthcare_largecap concentration, addressing the primary portfolio risk.
key_risks_or_contradictions: Dems score of 8 is below the 14 early rotation threshold, so daily flow data cannot independently drive conviction — weekly metrics must lead.
Ret_13w_vs_spy of 17.8% is moderate compared to top performers like PLTR at 27.3% and DPM.TO at 47.2%, indicating slower longer-term momentum.
Turkey_oil subtheme introduces localized geopolitical risk that could pressure the stock independent of broader oil_gas trends.
